brief.headline: Push them to the maker's price (they're a pure reseller) and qualify a second source now — they're in the distress zone and you're 7.21% of their sales.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to drop to the manufacturer's price; they're a reseller (100.0% traded), so their price carries a markup.
priceAsk.target: Cut ₹3.37 L/yr — match the ₹1.62/NOS Bprex charges us for the LDPE bottle (gap is 4.3%).
priceAsk.basis: They sell nothing they make — their price has a middleman margin. The market ask for similar caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc (typical ₹0.85–0.95), verdict 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec', so our target is fair.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Stay at 30 days — don't give them more time. They're already loss-making and owe 220.44× their own cash.

brief.financialLeverage: They're fragile: lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24, keep -199.2% profit (rivals keep 2.3%), and sit in the distress zone (Altman Z: -0.18). But you're a big customer — your ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue — so they need you. Their cash is stuck for 335d (rivals: 70d), so they'd value faster payment, but the real win is to push them to the maker's price (they're 100% a reseller) and line up a backup fast — don't lean hard enough to tip them over.

risks: They're loss-making (₹-22.50 Cr FY2023-24) and in the distress zone (Altman Z: -0.18) — pushing too hard on price could break supply; qualify a backup before you squeeze.
Money-health score is rock-bottom (1/10) — don't put all your volume through them.
They're 100% a reseller, so if they lose this margin they may walk — have Manjushree or Mold-Tek teed up before the call.
Their debt is 220.44× their own cash — a red flag for continuity; watch for any supply hiccups.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk price: you're a reseller, and we're paying a 4.3% premium over what we get direct — let's close that gap and grow the volume together.
